item.title: Two Massachusetts men accused of trafficking millions in SNAP benefits, selling donated meals intended for starving children
item.description: BOSTON – Federal authorities have arrested two men accused of orchestrating a multimillion-dollar fraud involving Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program benefits at small convenience stores they ran in Boston’s Mattapan neighborhood, where monthly redemptions reportedly soared to $500,000—dwarfing those of nearby full-service supermarkets. The scheme also allegedly included selling donated humanitarian meals meant for starving children overseas. […]
